query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_MERGERACQUISITION (MERGERACQUISITION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT MERGERACQUISITION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_MERGERACQUISITION WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT MERGERACQUISITION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_MERGERACQUISITION WHERE MERGERACQUISITION_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_MERGERACQUISITION SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MERGERACQUISITION_ID = ?
